title: Manchester City draw with Fulham to extend winless Premier League run to 4 games
text:
Manchester City draw with Fulham to extend winless Premier League run to 4 games - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 22일(일) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Manchester City draw with Fulham to extend winless Premier League run to 4 games 
 입력 2026.11.22. 00:31 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Manchester City failed to beat Fulham, extending its winless run in the Premier League to four games.
 Manchester City, coached by Enzo Maresca, drew 1-1 with Fulham in the 11th round of the 2026-27 Premier League season at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England, at 9:30 p.m. on the 21st (Korea time).
 The result ended City's three-game league losing streak, but it has now gone four games without a win. City remained third in the league with 22 points. Fulham, meanwhile, extended its unbeaten league run to five games (two wins, three draws).
 City lined up in a 4-2-3-1 formation. Erling Haaland led the attack, supported by Jeremy Doku, Phil Foden and Iliman Ndiaye. Elliott Anderson and Ayyoub Bouaddi formed the midfield.
 Fulham scored first. In the 16th minute, Rodrigo Muniz collected a pass from Oscar Bobb on the right and fired a right-footed shot into the top-right corner.
 Haaland put the ball in the net in the 24th minute, but the goal was disallowed. The referee ruled that Haaland had fouled goalkeeper Bernd Leno as Leno dealt with the ball.
 In the 35th minute, Haaland had a clear shooting chance inside the penalty area, but sent the ball high over the goal. City went into halftime trailing 1-0.
 City mounted a comeback after halftime. In the 12th minute, Phil Foden's corner deflected off a defender and fell to Anderson, who tried a right-footed volley from near the penalty area. His powerful shot flew into the net.
 It was Anderson's first Premier League goal since joining City.
 City had a chance to take the lead in the 20th minute. Anderson received a pass from Haaland and tried a left-footed shot inside the box, but the ball narrowly missed the goal.
 Fulham refused to back down. Gianluigi Donnarumma saved Muniz's shot in the 23rd minute, then denied Calvin Bassey's effort moments later to prevent another goal.
 City brought on Rayan Cherki and others to bolster its attack, but could not find a winner. The match ended in a 1-1 draw.
 The result also ended City's run of 20 consecutive wins in all competitions against Fulham. Its 17-game winning streak in Premier League meetings also came to an end.
 After the final whistle, home fans booed at Etihad Stadium. City ended its three-game losing streak but failed to claim all three points, and its poor run continues.
